items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: He came over with a super band led by Earl Hines with Max Kaminsky and Cozy Cole on drums... That was in ’57.

ctx.x: Well that’s the reason I stopped playing the trombone. I heard Jack Teagarden. I’d got over my Kid Ory phase. I could do a bit of that. And then I heard this man Teagarden and what he was doing with the trombone and I think I realized that I’d met my match. The moment had passed you know. Fabulous. Fabulous player. Saw him once. Saw him in ’57. He came over with a super band led by Earl Hines with Max Kaminsky and Cozy Cole on drums, and Jack Lesberg was playing the bass. That was in ’57. And we saw Teagarden…
